name: zdeclient_crater_build
description: zDEClient_Crater::Build clips the crater outline through ClipPatch, normalizes negative results to zero, and adopts returned clip-patch points when generated.
known_limits: The smoke target covers negative ClipPatch normalization and empty-output preservation; generated-point adoption is covered through the accepted ClipPatch output contract and deferred to the coherent zDEClient crater/clip-patch feature pass.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zDEClient crater/clip-patch source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4570e0 validates ClipPatch argument forwarding from the feature instance, result <= 0 handling, negative-result normalization to 0, null output-points return, optional old-points free, adoption of clipPatchOutput->points, pointCount update, and final result return.
The native crater build/create smoke verifies null feature inputs through ClipPatch normalize to 0 and a valid empty camera/grid-cell clip returns 0 without replacing the feature point buffer.
